senses.sense_definition: A pet scheme, favorite remedy, or questionable plan for solving a complex social or political problem.

examples.text: Politicians often rely on a familiar <w>nostrum</w> instead of addressing the real economic crisis.
The party promoted its latest political <w>nostrum</w> during the heated election campaign.

senses.sense_definition: A medicine or remedy, especially one prepared by an unqualified person, whose effectiveness is unproven or doubtful.

examples.text: The travelling salesman tried to sell an untested <w>nostrum</w> that promised to cure all ailments.
Desperate patients often waste money on an unproven herbal <w>nostrum</w>.
